newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to auction HUF 7bln of 7yr bonds on Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to auction HUF 7bln of 7yr bonds on Oct 10.

text.p: Hungary will auction 7 billion forint worth of the seven-year 2003/F government bond, which bears floating interest linked to inflation, on October 10, the Government Debt Management Agency (AKK said on Thursday.

NOTE - Up to 50 percent of the bonds sold at the auction will be offered to investors via subscription between October 14 and 18. The bond bears a floating interest, calculated on March 20 and September 20 every year adding three percent to year-on-year consumer inflation. The interest is paid once a year, on September 24. The starting interest is 25.9 percent.
